name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person across every site and consent, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Legal duties and the right to operate
sections.note: Breaches nobody owns, incidents the regulator has not heard about, notice deadlines, renewal windows and expired consents.
sections.sql: select site, item, rule, detail, days from site_attention where severity = 1 order by days desc nulls last, site

sections.title: Overdue and due soon
sections.sql: select site, item, rule, detail, days from site_attention where severity = 2 order by days desc nulls last, site

sections.title: Housekeeping
sections.sql: select site, item, rule, detail, days from site_attention where severity = 3 order by days desc nulls last, site

name: calendar
title: Compliance calendar
subtitle: Every condition overdue or due in the next 60 days, by date. Print it for the site meeting.

sections.title: Overdue
sections.sql: select site, consent, number as condition, summary, owner, next_due as was_due, days_overdue from condition_due where next_due < current_date order by next_due

sections.title: Due in the next 60 days
sections.sql: select site, consent, number as condition, summary, owner, next_due as due from condition_due where next_due between current_date and current_date + 60 order by next_due

name: consents
title: Consent register
subtitle: Every consent and licence, its expiry, the date to lodge the renewal by, and what is open against it.

sections.title: Renewals and lapse dates
sections.note: Lodge a renewal at least six months before expiry to keep operating while it is decided (RMA s124).
sections.sql: select code, site, authority_ref, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, expires_on, renew_by, days_to_renew_by, renewal_lodged_on, case when commenced_on is null then 'not given effect, lapses ' || lapse_on else '' end as lapse from consent_register where status = 'active' and (expires_on is not null or commenced_on is null) order by coalesce(renew_by, lapse_on)

sections.title: Every consent
sections.sql: select r.code, r.site, r.authority_ref, replace(r.kind, '_', ' ') as kind, r.activity, r.expires_on, (select count(*) from conditions co where co.consent_id = r.id and co.active)::int as conditions, (select count(*) from incidents i where i.consent_id = r.id and i.closed_on is null)::int as open_incidents from consent_register r order by r.site, r.code

name: monitoring
title: Monitoring against limits
subtitle: Breaches in the last year and the state of every water meter.

sections.title: Breaches of consent limits, last 12 months
sections.sql: select site, point, taken_on, parameter, case when qualifier = '=' then '' else qualifier end || value::float as result, unit, coalesce('max ' || max_value::float, 'min ' || min_value::float) as limit_value, condition, case when has_incident then 'yes' else 'NO' end as incident from reading_check where verdict in ('over limit','under minimum') and taken_on >= current_date - 365 order by taken_on desc

sections.title: Water takes of 5 L/s or more
sections.sql: select site, point, max_rate_ls::float as consented_ls, last_record, days_missing_30d, m3_30d, max_m3_day, days_over_30d, meter_verified_on, verify_by from water_take order by site, point
